deploy-bot: Deploy started -> env=staging, tag=release/v2.4.1-rc3, initiator=@samantha, services=[runtime, api, console]

samantha: kicking off smoke in staging — watching latency
ryan: on it, i'll watch the infra dashboards /prom alerts
deploy-bot: runtime: starting rollout (6 pods) commit=ab12f4e
deploy-bot: api: rolling out (12 instances) commit=ab12f4e
deploy-bot: console: starting, running db migrations step 1/3
alex: console migration step 2 -> writes look slow, seeing lock waits in logs
priya: @alex can you paste the migration log tail?
alex: ```
2026-03-20T11:30:42Z migration: applying 002_add_usage_indexes
2026-03-20T11:31:05Z db: waiting for exclusive lock on usage_summary
```
deploy-bot: runtime: healthcheck failing on 2/6 pods (503) — error: KV cache init timeout
samantha: runtime latency spike on canary traces. not good. recommend pinning runtime to previous stable while we investigate. @ryan @priya
ryan: agreed. pin runtime -> release/v2.4.0 (commit=7f9c1d2). i'll trigger a rollback of the runtime subset only.
priya: +1. hold console migrations until runtime stable to avoid cascading errors
deploy-bot: Pinning runtime -> release/v2.4.0 (commit=7f9c1d2) and initiating redeploy on runtime pool
deploy-bot: runtime: rolling back -> deployed release/v2.4.0 on 6 pods
deploy-bot: runtime: all pods Ready. healthchecks passing.
deploy-bot: api: unchanged (already succeeded)
deploy-bot: console: resuming migrations (step 2/3) after runtime stable
priya: migration finished, no more locks. console now at version release/v2.4.1-rc3
samantha: running smoke tests again — quick sanity checks passed, latency back to baselines
samantha: we should document this in the release notes and note that runtime was pinned due to KV cache regression; follow-up ticket created: INF-2376
ryan: adding rollback steps + monitoring checklist to the release doc. change window for prod rollout: 23:00-02:00 UTC
deploy-bot: Deploy finished (staging) -> summary: runtime=pinned->v2.4.0, api=deployed@ab12f4e, console=deployed@ab12f4e, start=1710923400, end=1710923700
samantha: thanks all — marking this staging deploy as blocked-for-investigation -> will gate prod until INF-2376 root cause is validated
ryan: ok, i'll coordinate a canary for prod with a reduced batch after we fix the kernel selection in the runtime. :thumbsup:
priya: noted. i'll follow up with postmortem notes on the migration timing and add mitigation steps.
